channel.title: Dad Joke of the Day
channel.description: A fresh dad joke every day. Get the app at dadjokes.vip

item.title: If New York is the city that never sleeps, what is the city that never wakes up?
item.description:
If New York is the city that never sleeps, what is the city that never wakes up?
Ta-coma

item.title: I dated this stunning girl once. She was a communist, originally from from China, but I met her while working in Switzerland. We lived in Denmark first then moved to Turkey and went on holiday in Canada. Then she cheated on me. I was devastated, but I really should have known better
item.description:
I dated this stunning girl once. She was a communist, originally from from China, but I met her while working in Switzerland. We lived in Denmark first then moved to Turkey and went on holiday in Canada. Then she cheated on me. I was devastated, but I really should have known better
There had been a lot of red flags

item.title: So my wife challenged me to a game of strip poker, but..
item.description:
So my wife challenged me to a game of strip poker, but..
turns out she just wanted to do laundry. So I folded.

item.title: What do you call an Irishman who bounces off walls?
item.description:
What do you call an Irishman who bounces off walls?
Rick O’Shea

item.title: I got robbed today and called the police
item.description:
I got robbed today and called the police
The cop asked if I had a descripion of the assailant. I said "yes, it's pump number 5."

item.title: A Higgs boson walked into a Catholic church and said...
item.description:
A Higgs boson walked into a Catholic church and said...
"whoa, whoa, whoa, you can't have mass without me"

item.title: I met a girl at a club the other night & she told me she'd show me a good time.
item.description:
I met a girl at a club the other night & she told me she'd show me a good time.
When we got outside, she ran a 40 yard dash in 4.8 seconds.

item.title: What did Yoda say when he saw himself in 4K?
item.description:
What did Yoda say when he saw himself in 4K?
"HDMI"

item.title: What do you call a test tube full of gross liquid?
item.description:
What do you call a test tube full of gross liquid?
A vile vial.

item.title: What is a stinky chicken?
item.description:
What is a stinky chicken?
A foul fowl.
